description_md: Segment start in UTC, from `datetime_start_local`: the cruise's recorded GMT offset where EDI knb-lter-cce.262.2 gives one (cruise_utc_offset.csv), else America/Los_Angeles clock time (Q04).
Segment end in UTC, converted as `datetime_start_utc`.
Segment midpoint latitude (mean of start and end), WGS84.
Segment midpoint longitude (mean of start and end), WGS84.
TRUE where the segment starts more than two months from its cruise label's month (segment 2886, CC2022-04 on 2022-11-05); such a segment gets no cruise_key.
CalCOFI cruise key (YYYY-MM-NODC) of the segment's cruise_label: track vote, else cruise_label_crosswalk.csv.
CalCOFI grid cell of the segment midpoint.
Row number of the sighting in the lab's workbook; primary key (the lab's UniqueID repeats on 3 pairs).
The segment's survey label (CCYYYY-MM), the sighting's own where its segment is missing.
The survey code the UniqueID starts with (CC0407, CC2204SH, CC202504SH).
survey_code reduced to CCYYMM, the key of cruise_label_crosswalk.csv.
Sighting time in UTC, converted from `datetime_local` as the segment times are (Q04).
Number of calves: `calf_raw` where it is a plain integer, else NULL (Q09).
Vocabulary key of species_codes.csv matched case-insensitively from `species_code_source`.
The segment's transect_flag: ON = on effort and on transect, OFF = on effort, off transect; NULL where the segment is missing.
CalCOFI cruise key (YYYY-MM-NODC) from `match_cruise_by_track()` (nearest ichthyo station occupied within a day, majority vote per cruise_label), else cruise_label_crosswalk.csv.
CalCOFI grid cell of the sighting position.
Scientific name the code is resolved from (authored in species_codes.csv; resolved against WoRMS by ensure_taxon_xref()).
